[element-term-display-string]
=== `<term-display-string>` Term-display String

Container element for narrative material to appear inside <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>> but outside, or between, the element content of <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>>.

#### Usage/Remarks
The element <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>> is a container element for other elements such as <<element-part-of-speech,`<part-of-speech>`>> and <<element-pronunciation,`<pronunciation>`>>. When there is text for <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>> that does not fit into one of the included elements, <<element-term-display-string,`<term-display-string>`>>, should be used to hold that text.
A <<element-term-display-string,`<term-display-string>`>> element is a bucket of text, in which other Term Display elements (such as Part of Speech) can be embedded. The idea is to use <<element-term-display-string,`<term-display-string>`>> to hold additional editorial text or other content that might have been generated, but has been placed explicitly in the XML instead. This allows a way to use, but constrain, text placed inside a <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>> element.

#### Tagged Sample

##### Using a <<element-term-display-string,`<term-display-string>`>>
[source,xml]
....
...
<term-display>
 <term term-status="preferred">Kapselung</term>
 <term-display-string>(en: <term xml:lang="en" 
   term-type="translation">enclosure</term>)</term-display-string>
 <def>
  <p>Teil einer gasisolierten, metallgekapselten Schaltanlage, ...</p>
 </def>
</term-display>
...
....
